content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，大家和欢迎来到英语播客。我的名字是马克。

content.text: My name is Catherine and a very Merry Christmas to everyone.
content.trans: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，祝大家圣诞快乐。

content.text: That's right, Merry Christmas. We are at that time again where we are celebrating Christmas.
content.trans: 英语：那对，圣诞快乐。我们再次庆祝圣诞节的时间。

content.text: We're having dinner with family and friends. We're giving presents.
content.trans: 我们正在和家人和朋友聚餐。我们准备了一些礼物。

content.text: And of course, there are some other traditions that come into play like for example Santa Claus.
content.trans: 英语：当然，还有其他传统，比如圣诞老人。

content.text: Santa Claus, so we've got a very special advanced level lesson for you today.
content.trans: 祝你今天的学习非常顺利！

content.text: We've got a poem. It's a very traditional poem that is red or listened to on the holiday.
content.trans: 我们有一首诗。这是一首非常传统的诗歌，红或在假期时被听到了。

content.text: And we're going to talk a little bit about some of the interesting words and phrases that are used in this.
content.trans: 英语：以及我们将讨论一些在这一主题中使用的有趣词汇和短语。

content.text: But first off, let's just listen to the poem itself.
content.trans: 但是首先，让我们听听这首诗。

content.text: The story of Christmas.
content.trans: 故事是圣诞节。

content.text: Tows the night before Christmas when all through the house, not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse.
content.trans: 晚上睡觉前，当整个房子都静悄悄的，连一只老鼠都没有动静。

content.text: The stockings were hung by the chimney with care, in hopes that St. Nicholas soon would be there.
content.trans: 英文：它们被挂在烟囱里，希望能很快见到圣尼古拉。

content.text: The children were nestled all snug in their beds while visions of sugar plums danced in their heads.
content.trans: 孩子们被紧紧地包裹在他们的床上，而他们脑海中浮现出糖浆的甜蜜景象。

content.text: And Mama and her Kirchiff and I in my camp had just settled down for a long winter's nap.
content.trans: A、和妈妈、她的克里希菲和我，我们在我的营地已经安顿下来度过了一个漫长的冬眠。

content.text: When out on the lawn there arose such a clatter. I sprang from the bed to see what was the matter.
content.trans: 英语：当我在草地上跑的时候，突然响起了这样的声音。我从床上跳了下来，去看发生了什么。

content.text: Away to the window I flew like a flash, tore open the shutters and threw open the sash.
content.trans: 英语：飞向窗户，像流星一样撕开了窗子和帘子。

content.text: The moon on the breast of the new fallen snow gave the luster of midday to objects below.
content.trans: 英文：月球的乳房为新落下的雪赋予了下午的光泽。

content.text: When what to my wondering eyes should appear but a miniature sleigh, an eight tiny reindeer.
content.trans: 英语：当我的眼睛疑惑不解时，一个八只小鹿的八角车。

content.text: With a little old driver so lively and quick, I knew in a moment it must be St. Nick.
content.trans: 英语：带着一点老司机的劲头，我一下子就明白了，这肯定就是圣约翰了。

content.text: More rapid than eagles his corsers they came and he whistled and shouted and called them by name.
content.trans: 英语：更快地比雄鹰快，它们来了，他鸣叫着、喊叫着，把他们叫了起来。

content.text: Now Dasha, now dancer, now prancer and vixen, on comet, on cupid, on donder and blitzen.
content.trans: 现在Dasha，现在舞者，现在旋子和狐狸，上天入地，上天入地。

content.text: To the top of the porch, to the top of the wall, now Dashaway, Dashaway, all.
content.trans: 英语：到屋顶顶，到墙顶，现在Dashaway，Dashaway，都。

content.text: As dry leaves that before the wild herghenes fly, when they meet with an obstacle mount to the sky.
content.trans: 英语：当那些在狂风中摇摆的树叶遇到障碍物时，它们会飞到天空。

content.text: So up to the housetop the corsers they flew with the sleighs full of toys and St. Nicholas too.
content.trans: 所以，上到屋顶的摄影师他们带着小车满载玩具和圣尼古拉也去了。

content.text: And then in a twinkling I heard on the roof the prancing and powing of each little hoof.
content.trans: 英语：然后在屋顶上，我听见了小蹄子在跳跃和嘶吼。

content.text: As I drew in my head and was turning round down the chimney St. Nicholas came with a bound.
content.trans: 英语：当我心中盘算着，转身下楼梯的圣尼古拉来了。

content.text: He was dressed on fur from his head to his toe and his clothes were all tarnished with ashes and soot.
content.trans: 他穿着毛皮从头到脚，衣服上都沾满了灰烬和烟尘。

content.text: A bundle of toys he had flung on his back and he looked like a peddler just opening his pack.
content.trans: 英文：一堆玩具他把背在了身上，看上去像个小贩刚打开他的包。

content.text: His eyes how they twinkled, his dimples how merry.
content.trans: 他的眼睛多么明亮，他的凹陷的笑容多么可爱。

content.text: His cheeks were like roses, his nose like a cherry.
content.trans: 他的脸颊像玫瑰，鼻子像樱桃。

content.text: His drool little mouth was drawn up in a bow and the beard of his chin was as white as the smell.
content.trans: 他的小嘴被画成了一个弯弓，胡子都白得跟气味一样。

content.text: The stump of a pipe he held tight in his teeth and the smoke and encircled his head like a wreath.
content.trans: 这个愚公的木桩紧紧地握在牙齿之间，烟雾和包围在他的头上就像一个花环。

content.text: He had a broad face in the little round belly that shook when he laughed like a bowl full of jelly.
content.trans: 他有一张小圆腹，笑起来就像一个满载的碗。

content.text: He was chubby and plump, a rightle jelly elf and I laughed when I saw him in spite of myself.
content.trans: 他个子高，胖得像只小猪，我看到他时忍不住笑出声来。

content.text: A wink of his eye and a twist of his head soon gave me to know I had nothing to dread.
content.trans: 英语：他眨了眨眼，扭了扭脑袋，很快我就知道我没有什么要担心的。

content.text: He spoke not a word but went straight to work and filled all the stockings then turned with a jerk and laying his finger
content.trans: 他一句话也没说，就直接去了工作，然后转身，用手指一弹，甩着尾巴，一脸得意。

content.text: a side of his nose and giving a nod up the chimney he rose.
content.trans: 他的鼻子上有一块侧边，向烟囱方向鞠躬。他起身了。

content.text: He sprang to his sleigh to his team gave a whistle and the way they all flew like the down of a whistle.
content.trans: 他冲向他的车队，吹响了号角，他们像一只飞得低的鸟一样，就像那辆小铃铛。

content.text: But I heard him exclaim air as he drove out of sight.
content.trans: 但是当我看到他从视野中消失时，我听到他大声喊道：“空气！”

content.text: Happy Christmas to all and to all a good night!
content.trans: 祝大家圣诞快乐，愿你和所有的人都度过一个美好的夜晚！

content.text: Alright we're back so the poem is very nice.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经回来，所以这首诗非常好。

content.text: It's long and just to recap what the poem is talking about.
content.trans: 英语：它很短，只是用来总结一下这首诗的内容。

content.text: What is the general story of the poem?
content.trans: 诗歌的总体故事是什么？

content.text: The story of the poem is that Santa Claus is coming to visit someone's house and there's a person in the story who is watching Santa Claus arrive.
content.trans: 故事中的诗是：圣诞老人来了，有人在故事里看到一个正在观看圣诞老人到来的人。

content.text: He's seeing Santa Claus take the reindeer up onto the roof, come down the chimney and lay the presents out for the children filling the stockings as well.
content.trans: 他正在屋顶上看到圣诞老人把驯鹿送上烟囱，然后将礼物放在孩子们的袜子里。

content.text: It's basically a nice poetic description of Santa Claus and it goes into a very nice way the way Santa Claus looks like.
content.trans: 英文：它基本上是圣诞老人和他看起来非常像的描述。

content.text: It's very descriptive. We have descriptions of what Santa Claus looks like, what he's wearing, his smile, how he's a little bit fat.
content.trans: 英语：它非常描述性。我们有关于圣诞老人的描述，他穿什么衣服，他的微笑有点小，他有点胖。

content.text: We also have descriptions of the animals, the special animals that we hear about so often that are called reindeer.
content.trans: 我们还有一部分动物的描述，这些动物我们经常听到说叫做驯鹿。

content.text: Alright so we've divided up the poem into by line so then it's going to be easier for you to go to the line that we're talking about.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经将诗歌分成每一行了，这样你就可以更容易地找到我们要讨论的那一行。

content.text: Let's start with the first line with this first word that's actually very interesting.
content.trans: 让我们从这个第一个单词的第一个部分开始，这确实很有意思。

content.text: Was the night before Christmas when all through the house?
content.trans: 英语：昨晚的夜，整个房子都笼罩在寂静中。

content.text: So what does this first word mean?
content.trans: 请告诉我这个第一个单词的意思。

content.text: It's a short version of it was.
content.trans: 这是它的短版本。

content.text: Okay so but do you actually use this now in like if you're writing?
content.trans: 英语：是的，所以你实际上现在使用这个吗？

content.text: No this is not something I would use now in writing and it's not something I would say.
content.trans: 英语：它不是一个我现在用来写和说的东西。

content.text: It's actually more of an archaic form, something that you might hear in poetry or historical writing.
content.trans: 实际上，它更像是一种古老的形态，你可能会在诗歌或历史写作中听到。

content.text: Okay so it was the night before Christmas right so we're talking about December 24th.
content.trans: 好的，那么现在请告诉我关于圣诞节的日期。

content.text: The night of December 24th that's right.
content.trans: 晚上12月24日。

content.text: Alright so the first two lines talk about how it was the night before Christmas and in the house there was nothing stirring, not even a mouse.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: So not even the smallest little animal so it's very quiet in the house is what's happening.
content.trans: 所以，即使是最小的动物，它在房子中的声音也是如此之低。

content.text: So now we jump to line number seven where the poet describes and mama in her crutchiff and I in my cap.
content.trans: 所以现在我们跳到第七行，诗人描述了和妈妈在她的拐杖上，我穿着我的帽子。

content.text: So we know that the person talking is the dad because he's talking about himself and mama, mother.
content.trans: 所以我们知道这个说话的人是爸爸，因为他正在谈论他自己和妈妈。

content.text: They're in bed together and mama in her crutchiff and I in my cap so I'm wearing a night cap, a cover on my head, like a hat.
content.trans: 他们床边并排，妈妈在她的拐杖鞋里，我戴了一顶帽子，帽子戴在我的头上，就像帽子。

content.text: And mama has a crutchiff.
content.trans: 妈妈有拐杖。

content.text: What's the crutchiff?
content.trans: 英语：什么是一点办法？

content.text: A crutchiff is another abbreviation short for hand crutchiff.
content.trans: 英文：一个拐杖是另一个缩写短语“手杖”的另一种形式。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And a hand crutchiff is a piece of fabric or cloth that sometimes we use for our noses when we have to blow our nose.
content.trans: 而且，一个手杖式面具有时我们用来在鼻子上擦鼻涕。

content.text: But also you can use a crutchiff in your hair to cover your hair.
content.trans: 但是，你也可以使用卷发棒在头发上覆盖你的头发。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So if you can imagine at this must take place, I don't know maybe 50, 60 years ago when dads used to wear hats to bed and women also hand crutchiffs on their hair.
content.trans: 所以，如果你们能想象一下，也许50、60年前，当爸爸们会戴帽子睡觉，而女士也会用拐杖在头发上行走。

content.text: Or longer, maybe 200 years ago when people wore these long night hats.
content.trans: 英语：或者更长，也许在200年前人们戴着这些长夜帽子。

content.text: Right, caps.
content.trans: 正确答案：英语：Right, caps.

content.text: The pajamas and everything.
content.trans: 《睡衣和一切》。

content.text: Alright, now let's jump over to line 18 and 19 when he's talking about the reindeer and the sleigh arriving and he says,
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: I knew in a moment it must be Saint Nick.
content.trans: 我立刻就知道这是圣尼古拉。

content.text: This is another way of calling Santa Claus, right?
content.trans: 这个是另一种叫圣诞老人的方式，对吗？

content.text: Saint Nicholas is his name but you also call him Claus or Santa Claus.
content.trans: 英文：圣尼古拉是他的名字，但你也可以称呼他为克劳斯或圣诞老人。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And then he said more rapid than Eagles, his corsairs they came.
content.trans: 英语：然后他说话的速度比鹰快，他的海盗来了。

content.text: So the word order is a bit strange here.
content.trans: 英语：所以这里的词序有点奇怪。

content.text: This is common in poetry.
content.trans: 这个在诗歌中是常见的。

content.text: We could also say his corsairs came more rapidly than Eagles.
content.trans: 我们也可以说他的海盗比鹰队更快。

content.text: They were very, very fast.
content.trans: 他们非常快速。

content.text: But what are these corsairs we're talking about the animals pulling Santa Claus and what are those animals again?
content.trans: 但是这些海盗我们正在讨论的是驯鹿，它们又是什么动物呢？

content.text: They're called reindeer.
content.trans: 他们被称作驯鹿。

content.text: So the reindeer are very, very fast.
content.trans: 所以驯鹿非常快。

content.text: Okay, that's right because he's making the comparison about how fast Eagles are compared to them.
content.trans: 好的，那请你提供一些具体的英语句子和要求。我会尽力准确地将其翻译成简化中文。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And we hear their names, right?
content.trans: And 我们听到他们的名字，对吗？

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正好。

content.text: He goes on to say now, dash her, now, dancer, now, prancer.
content.trans: 英语：他现在继续说，快点，舞者、节奏者、旋木。

content.text: And all of their names, Vickson, Comet, Cupid, Donder and Blitzen.
content.trans: 和他们的名字一样，Vickson、Comet、Cupid、Donder 和 Blitzen。

content.text: All eight reindeer, each animal has its own name.
content.trans: 所有八只驯鹿，每只动物都有自己的名字。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So all eight reindeer, actually we're missing one though that's very common nowadays.
content.trans: 所以，八只驯鹿，实际上我们目前缺少一只，这在今天很常见。

content.text: The reindeer that goes in the front lighting illuminating the sky.
content.trans: 在前面的灯光下，驯鹿在照亮天空。

content.text: Rudolph, the red nose reindeer.
content.trans: 红鼻子小兔子 Rudolph.

content.text: You might know the song Rudolph, the red nose reindeer.
content.trans: 英语：你可能知道这首歌《红鼻子小兔子》。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: We've made nine reindeer nowadays, but I guess the story was before the Rudolph story came out.
content.trans: 我们已经养了九只驯鹿，但我想起罗丹的故事了。

content.text: Alright, so those are, this is interesting because those are the names of all the reindeer.
content.trans: 好的，所以这些是有趣的，因为这些都是所有驯鹿的名字。

content.text: Now, I'm not sure which order they are.
content.trans: 现在，我不确定他们是什么顺序。

content.text: I don't know who's in the back who's in the front.
content.trans: 我不会知道谁在后边，谁在前面。

content.text: Yeah, I don't know either.
content.trans: 嗯，我也不太清楚。

content.text: But it's important to know that they're very fast and they come down and then they go up.
content.trans: 但是知道他们非常快，然后又会下降。

content.text: They have to take St. Nicholas to the roof of the house on top of the house.
content.trans: 他们必须把圣尼古拉送到房子的屋顶。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So now he arrives to the top of the house.
content.trans: 所以现在他来到了顶楼。

content.text: At 32 we see down the chimney St. Nicholas came with a bound.
content.trans: 在32岁，我们看到烟囱下的圣尼古拉。

content.text: He came quickly down the chimney.
content.trans: 他很快就下了烟囱。

content.text: Boom.
content.trans: 爆！

content.text: And at the end, he's all dressed in fur from his head to his foot.
content.trans: 英语：然后，他从头到脚都穿着毛皮袍。

content.text: So top to bottom he has fur on.
content.trans: 所以，他有毛发从上到下。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: And I think he's got fur because he lives in the North Pole, right?
content.trans: 我猜他有毛，因为他在北极生活。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: It's very cold where Santa Claus lives.
content.trans: 英语：它很冷的地方，圣诞老人住在那里。

content.text: So he has to wear these clothes that are very warm.
content.trans: 所以他得穿这些很暖和的衣服。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And obviously since he is going up and down chimneys in line 34, we see and his clothes were
content.trans: 当然，因为他在三十四号的烟囱里来回穿梭，我们看到他的衣服。

content.text: tarnished with ashes and sutt.
content.trans: 英文：沾满尘埃和灰烬。

content.text: So to tarnish or tarnished means dirty.
content.trans: 所以污点或污渍的意思是脏的。

content.text: Something is tarnished if it's dirty.
content.trans: 如果某物污浊，那么它就沾染了污秽。

content.text: So his clothes, his fur clothes were dirty with ashes and sutt.
content.trans: 所以他的衣服，尤其是他的毛衣，都被烧得乌七八糟了。

content.text: This means that in your fireplace, when the fire is gone, there's some gray and black stuff.
content.trans: 这个意味着，在你的火炉里，当火熄灭时，会有一些灰色和黑色的东西。

content.text: And that's what's on Santa Claus' clothes.
content.trans: 这是圣诞老人的衣服。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 很好。

content.text: So, and then we go on to line 35, a bundle of toys he had flung on his back.
content.trans: 所以，然后我们继续到第35行，他把他的玩具扔到了后背上。

content.text: And he looked like a peddler just opening his pack.
content.trans: And he looked like a peddler just opening his pack. (注：这里的“peddler”是中文的“小贩”，在中文里常用来指代一个不知名、价格低廉的商品。)

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的，以下是“所有好”的翻译：

content.text: A peddler.
content.trans: A 皮包商。

content.text: Now this is not just something we talk about.
content.trans: 现在这不是我们讨论的话题。

content.text: On Christmas, you know, we have peddlers all year round.
content.trans: 英语：在圣诞节，你知道，我们都有售货员一年四季。

content.text: What are peddlers?
content.trans: What are 什么？

content.text: What do they do?
content.trans: 他们做什么？

content.text: Basically they go around selling things.
content.trans: 基本来说，他们主要通过销售来赚钱。

content.text: So maybe you see them in a small market or sometimes in different places and maybe, I don't know, on the streets.
content.trans: 所以，也许你能在小市场或不同地方看到他们，或者在街头看到。

content.text: You see them selling little things like toys or combs or books, something like that.
content.trans: 英语：你看到他们正在卖小玩意，比如玩具、梳子或书，类似这样的东西。

content.text: Oranges you see or fruit peddlers.
content.trans: 苹果你看到了，水果摊贩。

content.text: People who sell fruit or you can see those watch peddlers.
content.trans: 人们可以看那些卖水果的售货员。

content.text: You know, they say, would you like a Rolex watch?
content.trans: 英语：你知道，他们说，你想要一只劳力士手表吗？

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Watch peddler.
content.trans: 英语：观看小贩。

content.text: So that's what they do, right?
content.trans: 所以，这就是他们干的吧？

content.text: They're informal salesmen.
content.trans: 他们都是推销员。

content.text: They don't have a store.
content.trans: 他们没有商店。

content.text: They work on the street.

content.text: So this is why Santa looks like a peddler.
